chunks: "And if you forget until you stand in salat (prayer), then I do not command you to repeat it."

key_terms.تَقُومَ: you stand up or enter into prayer

ai.seo_question: If someone forgets a detail of wudu (ablution) until after starting salat, must the prayer be repeated?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding one who forgot a required act connected to wudu (ablution) until after entering salat (prayer). Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that such a person is not commanded to repeat the salat, indicating leniency in the case of forgetfulness.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.107 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"And if you forget (to rotate your ring in ablution) until you stand in Salat, then I do not command you to repeat it (Salat)."
